stem: Both groups of an A/B test have a few baskets above €1,000. The analyst caps baskets at €1,000 in the treatment group only, because the largest basket is there. What does this do to the comparison?

options.text: It biases it against the treatment, whose large baskets alone are cut
It removes noise fairly, since a cap only touches a few rare baskets anyway
It biases the comparison in favour of the treatment
It changes the median basket of the treatment, but not its mean
